description:
Stockholm, No: 23.

January 29th, 1780, Saturday.

Daily News,
or:
All-Around Daily.

On Thursday the 27th of January, the temperature was recorded at -2°C and the barometer reading was 26.00 mmHg. Up until Friday morning, it had been 3 degrees below freezing with little snowfall.

Tomorrow, Ash Wednesday or Sexagesima Sunday, the following preachers will be delivering sermons:
At King's Court: Royal Chapel Preacher Andersson.
At Queen Dowager's Court: Royal Chapel Preacher Kellin.
At Prince of Södermanland's Court: Royal Chapel Preacher Reinholdson.
In the Royal Palace Chapel: Royal Chapel Preachers Aroffen High Mass; Royal Chapel Preacher Collin Evening Service.
St. Nicolai Church: Commisary Lindström Evening Service; Royal Chapel Preacher Könner High Mass; Battalion Preacher Jungblad Evening Service.
St. Clarå Church: Commisary Ruth Evening Service; Royal Chapel Preacher Wallquist High Mass; Come win. Witringah Evening Service.
For the Royal Life Guards: Battalion Preacher Risberg.
St. Jacobi Church: Commisary Gravallius Evening Service; Royal Chapel Preacher Bergsen High Mass; Royal Chapel Preachers and Commisary Arrhenius Evening Service.
For the Royal Life Guards: Battalion Preacher Lundman.
Royal Riddarholms Church: Magister Hambräus High Mass; Commisary Norborg Evening Service.
German Church: Pastor Noodt High Mass; Doctor Lüdeke Evening Service.
St. Maria Magdalen Church: Commisary Ehrling Evening Service; Pastor Helsingberg High Mass; Commisary Krause Evening Service.
For the Royal Life Guards: Regimental Pastor Cederblom.
St. Catharina Church: Magister Neuström Evening Service; Magister Loewvander High Mass; Commisary Nordmark Evening Service.
Ulrick Eleonork Church: Priest Asplund High Mass; Magister Granberg Evening Service.
Finnish National Church: Commisary Ohman both Finnish and Swedish High Masses; Magister Stählsberg Evening Service.
French Lutheran Church: Commisary Gerdin.
Sedvig Eleonork Church: Magister Odeen Evening Service; Royal Chapel Preachers and Priest Es peroth High Mass; Commisary Grooth Evening Service.
Adolph Fredrichs Church: Magister Niekkin High Mass; Candidate Ekström Evening Service.
St. John's Church: Magister Roempke High Mass; Commisary Lindlöf Evening Service.
The Royal Artillery Church: Pastor Callerholm High Mass; Magister Björcklad Evening Service.
For S.R.Maj:t Queen Dowager's Life Regiment: Battalion Preacher Roos.
St. Barnabas Church: Priest Hjortsbera High Mass; Commisary Collander Evening Service.
Skeppsholms Church: Magister Lithander High Mass; Commisary Fogelquist Evening Service.
The Royal Palace Church: Royal Chapel Preacher Nibelius.
Danviks Church: Priest Lavin High Mass; Schoolmaster Löhman Evening Service.
Krono Spinbus Church: Magister Tegman.
Enkhus Church: Regimental Preachers Strandberg.
Sabbathsbergs Church: Magister Mebius.
Foreign News:
Constantinople, December 8th. The dispatches sent by Russian Emperor's Minister Herr von Stachief about four weeks ago from the Imperial Court in Crimea had initially given rise to suspicion between us and Russia; however, later letters received from Crimea indicate that relations are now back on good terms.
